"'''Talk'''" is a song by American singer [[Khalid (American singer)|Khalid]]. It was written by Khalid and produced by English [[electronic music]] duo [[Disclosure (band)|Disclosure]]. It was released on February 7, 2019, as the first single from Khalid's second studio album, ''[[Free Spirit (Khalid album)|Free Spirit]]''.<ref name="Billboard">{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/music/pop/khalid-new-song-talk-release-date-8496385/|title=Khalid & Disclosure Drop New Single 'Talk': Listen|magazine=Billboard|access-date=February 10, 2019}}</ref>{{efn-ua|Khalid's own Spotify account previously stated on one of its playlists "New song "Talk" with Disclosure on 2/7", but now no longer does. However, the quote is still archived by Google and can be searched.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://open.spotify.com/user/thegreatkhalid/playlist/53EV6ylFWqPfiUyyKuotwv|title=Khalid Talk on Spotify|via=[[Spotify]]|access-date=February 6, 2019|quote=New song "Talk" with Disclosure on 2/7}}</ref>}} The song also appeared in the deluxe edition of Disclosure's third studio album, ''[[Energy (Disclosure album)|Energy]]''. "Talk" became Khalid's fifth top 10 hit and highest-charting single as a solo artist in the US, peaking at number three on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]].<ref name="Hot 100 peak">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/pro/lil-nas-x-old-town-road-hot-100-number-one-ninth-week/|title=Lil Nas X's 'Old Town Road' Tops Billboard Hot 100 for Ninth Week, the Most This Year, & DaBaby's 'Suge' Hits Top 10|magazine=Billboard|last=Trust|first=Gary|date=June 3, 2019|access-date=June 4, 2019}}</ref> The song was nominated for [[Grammy Award for Record of the Year|Record of the Year]] at the [[62nd Annual Grammy Awards|62nd Grammy Awards]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.grammy.com/artists/khalid/187821|title=Khalid Grammys History|date=November 26, 2019|website=[[The Recording Academy]]|access-date=January 1, 2019}}</ref>

''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' ranked "Talk" 29th on their 100 Best Songs of 2019 list.<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/articles/news/list/8545893/best-songs-of-2019-top-100|title=The 100 Best Songs of 2019: Staff List |magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|date=December 11, 2019|access-date=December 30, 2019}}</ref>

"Talk" is a song by American singer Khalid. It was written by Khalid and produced by English electronic music duo Disclosure. It was released on February 7, 2019, as the first single from Khalid's second studio album, Free Spirit.{{efn-ua|Khalid's own Spotify account previously stated on one of its playlists "New song "Talk" with Disclosure on 2/7", but now no longer does. However, the quote is still archived by Google and can be searched.}} The song also appeared in the deluxe edition of Disclosure's third studio album, Energy. "Talk" became Khalid's fifth top 10 hit and highest-charting single as a solo artist in the US, peaking at number three on the Billboard Hot 100. The song was nominated for Record of the Year at the 62nd Grammy Awards.

Billboard ranked "Talk" 29th on their 100 Best Songs of 2019 list.

sections.heading: Music and composition
sections.wikitext:
"Talk" is a midtempo, [[contemporary R&B|R&B]]-tinged<ref name="Billboard"/> song that runs for 3 minutes and 17 seconds.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/talk-single/1451262392|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190212011704/https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/talk-single/1451262392|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 12, 2019|title=Talk – Single by Khalid|via=[[Apple Music]]|access-date=February 10, 2019}}</ref> It features production and songwriting by English electronic music duo [[Disclosure (band)|Disclosure]], who incorporate [[Synthesizer|synths]] that "bubble and twinkle above a [[staccato]] bass".<ref name="complex best">{{Cite web|url=https://www.complex.com/music/new-music-this-week/ariana-grande-nasa|title=The Best New Music This Week|last=Bernucca|first=Carolyn|date=February 9, 2019|work=[[Complex (magazine)|Complex]]|access-date=July 17, 2019}}</ref> Carolyn Bernucca of ''[[Complex (magazine)|Complex]]'' magazine noted how Khalid "opts for a more mature vocal sound [...] without losing the youthful charm he's employed since ''[[American Teen (album)|American Teen]]''".<ref name="complex best" />

Speaking on the conception of the song, Khalid said he initially met up with Disclosure, and they played him what he called a "crazy-ass instrumental".<ref name="Billboard"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/post/sa.d8b393e0-2ab7-11e9-87b0-8520ee47d64a|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190212011545/https://itunes.apple.com/us/post/sa.d8b393e0-2ab7-11e9-87b0-8520ee47d64a|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 12, 2019|title=Watch 'Khalid on "Talk"' posted by Zane Lowe on Apple Music|via=[[Apple Music]]|access-date=February 10, 2019}}</ref> Khalid described "Talk" as the first taste of his second album, with the song's theme being "the beginning [[honeymoon]] stages of a relationship". ''[[Rap-Up]]'' said the song finds the singer "navigating the waters of a relationship".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rap-up.com/2019/02/07/new-music-khalid-talk/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190207220455/https://www.rap-up.com/2019/02/07/new-music-khalid-talk/|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 7, 2019|title=New Music: Khalid – 'Talk'|work=[[Rap-Up]]|access-date=February 10, 2019}}</ref>
sections.text:
"Talk" is a midtempo, R&B-tinged song that runs for 3 minutes and 17 seconds. It features production and songwriting by English electronic music duo Disclosure, who incorporate synths that "bubble and twinkle above a staccato bass". Carolyn Bernucca of Complex magazine noted how Khalid "opts for a more mature vocal sound [...] without losing the youthful charm he's employed since American Teen".

Speaking on the conception of the song, Khalid said he initially met up with Disclosure, and they played him what he called a "crazy-ass instrumental". Khalid described "Talk" as the first taste of his second album, with the song's theme being "the beginning honeymoon stages of a relationship". Rap-Up said the song finds the singer "navigating the waters of a relationship".

sections.heading: Promotion and release
sections.wikitext:
Khalid officially announced the song on [[Twitter]] on February 4, 2019, posting the cover art, which shows a purple wolf behind red flames.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://muzotakt.pl/58509/nowy-khalid-talk/|title=Nowy Khalid we czwartek ("Talk" nowym singlem)|website=Muzotakt|language=pl|date=February 4, 2019|access-date=February 6, 2019}}</ref> In late January, he had posted a video of himself listening to a clip of the song in his car.<ref name="Announce">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/music/pop/khalid-new-song-talk-release-date-8496385/|title=Khalid Announces Release Date for New Song 'Talk'|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|last=Acevedo|first=Angelica|date=February 4, 2019|access-date=February 6, 2019}}</ref> "Talk" was premiered as [[Zane Lowe]]'s World Record on [[Apple Music]]'s [[Beats 1]] radio on February 7, 2019, and released the same day.<ref name="Billboard"/>

On August 28, 2020, "Talk" was also included as the 18th track in the deluxe edition of Disclosure's third studio album, ''[[Energy (Disclosure album)|Energy]]''.
sections.text:
Khalid officially announced the song on Twitter on February 4, 2019, posting the cover art, which shows a purple wolf behind red flames. In late January, he had posted a video of himself listening to a clip of the song in his car. "Talk" was premiered as Zane Lowe's World Record on Apple Music's Beats 1 radio on February 7, 2019, and released the same day.

On August 28, 2020, "Talk" was also included as the 18th track in the deluxe edition of Disclosure's third studio album, Energy.

sections.heading: Chart performance
sections.wikitext: The song would go on to reach a peak of number three for four non-consecutive weeks on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]], and spent 11 weeks at the top of the Hot 100 Airplay chart, in addition to topping the Pop Songs, Rhythmic Songs, and Hip-Hop/R&B Airplay charts.

sections.heading: Remixes
sections.wikitext:
[[Disclosure (band)|Disclosure]], who produced the original song, released their own [[House music|house]] remix of "Talk" on March 29, 2019. This version of the song is titled "Talk (Disclosure VIP)".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://runthetrap.com/2019/03/29/disclosure-unleash-creative-vip-for-khalid-collaboration-talk/|title=Disclosure Unleash Creative VIP For Khalid Collaboration "Talk"|date=March 29, 2019|website=Run The Trap|access-date=April 29, 2019}}</ref>

A second official remix of "Talk" with American rappers [[Megan Thee Stallion]] and [[Yo Gotti]] was released on April 12, 2019.<ref name="remix">{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/khalid-talk-remix-megan-thee-stallion-yo-gotti-8506917/|title=Khalid Taps Megan Thee Stallion & Yo Gotti for 'Talk' Remix: Listen|magazine=Billboard|access-date=April 29, 2019}}</ref> ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' magazine reacted positively to Megan's verse, calling it "steamy", and complimented her singing but was less approving of Yo Gotti's feature, saying his "appearance feels much like he just stumbled into the wrong house and didn't know what he was getting himself into".<ref name="remix" />
sections.text:
Disclosure, who produced the original song, released their own house remix of "Talk" on March 29, 2019. This version of the song is titled "Talk (Disclosure VIP)".

A second official remix of "Talk" with American rappers Megan Thee Stallion and Yo Gotti was released on April 12, 2019. Billboard magazine reacted positively to Megan's verse, calling it "steamy", and complimented her singing but was less approving of Yo Gotti's feature, saying his "appearance feels much like he just stumbled into the wrong house and didn't know what he was getting himself into".
